names: Sodium, potassium and calcium salts of fatty acids (emulsifier)

more_info.uses: EU permissions include table-top sweeteners in tablets, herbs and spices. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Salts are prepared from fatty acids obtained from edible fats or oils. Sodium, potassium or calcium provides the salt-forming component.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The fatty-acid feedstock is not specified as exclusively plant derived. Vegan, vegetarian, halal and kosher suitability cannot be established without the supplier identifying the raw material and processing.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA found no concern for assessed food uses.
The reviewed evidence did not indicate mutagenic or cancer effects.
more_info.overview: Sodium is classified in food technology as an anti-caking agent. Its technological role is to keep powders free-flowing.
